subject: PO routing anomaly — safelist request & corrected line items
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@acmeco.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acmeco.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO assignment mismatch & spend cap blocking onboarding

Hi Dylan,

We're in the final stages of getting Acme LiveEdge onboarded with Redwood but hit a roadblock on the PO side. Your portal generated PO #PO-2026-9812 for our initial commit, but our AP system shows the PO routed to an internal ledger id that doesn't map to the spend cap bucket we negotiated during procurement (monthly ceiling $60k). The result: our vendor portal shows "PO holds: spend cap exceeded" and the onboarding form keeps flagging ledger mismatch.

I've attached the onboarding form (v3) and a CSV export from our AP system that shows the mapping the Redwood PO created (ledger_id: L-77) vs. the expected ledger (L-52). Can you review? We need either a reissued PO mapped to L-52 or a temporary spend cap increase while we finalize the billing code mapping — the customer can't go live with tokenized billing until invoices flow to the expected ledger.

We also noticed two SKU line items got combined on your export (SKU-AX12 & SKU-AX12-SUB collapsed into a single line), which will fail our reconciliation. I'd appreciate a quick response since our implementation window is this week.

Best,
Sophie Lane
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Creative Labs
Attachments: ACME_onboard_form_v3.pdf, acme_po_lines_export.csv
From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@acmeco.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO assignment mismatch & spend cap blocking onboarding

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear notes and the attachments. I'm flagging this to procurement and finance. Quick summary of the path forward:

- Monica (procurement ops) to validate ledger mapping and either remap PO PO-2026-9812 to ledger L-52 or issue a corrected PO number (expected by EOD Thu).
- Ben (billing) to approve a 7-day temporary spend-cap lift to allow initial provisioning while ledgers are reconciled. Ben — can you confirm?
- Internal action: we'll re-export the line items in the format your AP expects (separate rows for SKU-AX12 and SKU-AX12-SUB) and attach the corrected CSV back to you.

Sophie — I'll keep you posted in-thread. Monica, Ben — looping you for action. Please use the Jira link (PROC-5821) when you update status so Acme can track.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0128
From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO assignment mismatch & spend cap blocking onboarding

Hi team,

I dug into the issuance logs and found a routing rule (legacy mapping rule #LM-18) applied during the PO stamping process — that pushed PO-2026-9812 to ledger L-77 instead of L-52. The rule was supposed to be retired in July but didn't pick up in the ruleset update we deployed.

Actions taken:
- Marked LM-18 as deprecated in the orchestration layer.
- Drafted a corrected PO (PO-2026-9812-R1) that maps to ledger L-52. It's staged and awaiting Ben's temporary approval for the spend-cap override so we can provision immediately.
- Re-generated the vendor line export with separate rows for SKU-AX12 and SKU-AX12-SUB. Attached: acme_po_lines_corrected.csv and PO_request_authorization.png (screenshot of the staged PO).

Sophie — once Ben gives spend-cap permission, I can publish the replacement PO and notify your AP. If Finance prefers not to do a temporary cap lift, we can mark provisioning as "pending ledger remediation" and schedule a forced re-issue with a 48-hour SLA.

Monica
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: acme_po_lines_corrected.csv, PO_request_authorization.png

Thanks for the investigation. I reviewed the request and approve a one-time 7-day temporary spend-cap increase for Acme (from $60,000 to $85,000) to cover provisioning while procurement remaps the ledger. Conditions:

- Monica must publish PO-2026-9812-R1 and confirm mapping to L-52 within 24 hours of this approval.
- All invoice submissions during the temporary window must include the PO amendment ID in the description.
- Billing will revert the cap automatically after 7 days unless a support case to extend is opened (PROC-5821).

Monica — please publish the corrected PO and confirm when the vendor has been notified. Sophie/Jared — Dylan or Monica will send the final PO and corrected CSV; once you confirm receipt I will release provisioning authorization to the integrations team.

Ben Carter
Head of Billing | Redwood Inference
